text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Milady... Will the dinner party proceed as 
scheduled, then? Perhaps you should rest 
until your headache subsides—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No. I cannot afford to rest over something 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing serious. There is no need 
for concern.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Well then, class is about to start, so 
please excuse me.

And so, Daiichi Ruby was plagued by a 
headache for a while...
